description:
Check if stored DNS credentials have access to a domain. Use before triggering verification to confirm the credentials work.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.

id.description: Domain ID to check credentials for

name: check_domain_credentials

outputSchema.description: Which of the account's DNS credentials can reach a domain

can_try_ownership_verification.description: A registrar credential can confirm ownership while the zone is served elsewhere.

has_credentials.description: Whether the account holds any valid DNS credential. When false, only `accessible_credentials` (empty), `detected_provider` and `suggestion` are sent.

suggestion.description: Sent when no credential can reach the domain.
